entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: So this is a slave camp... The décor[n]is bizarrely cheery for such a horrid[n]place...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: I'm surprised one is operating in the[n]heart of the city like this.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: I had originally thought such places would[n]need to hide in the shadows, far from[n]public scrutiny.

entries.speaker: Clara
entries.en: *giggle* Welcome home, Master!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Are you addressing me? You are sorely[n]mistaken about who is your master...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: We've come here to observe fully, Justine.[n]Don't worry, we'll free her when we're[n]finished.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Hey, you.

entries.speaker: Clara
entries.en: Yes, Master?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Tell me, why are you grinning like that?[n]You're a slave.

entries.speaker: Clara
entries.en: Huh? A... slave? Whatever do you mean,[n]Master?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Maybe you're ordered to smile, but what?[n]Do you lack a will of rebellion? Or are[n]you just naturally submissive?

entries.speaker: Clara
entries.en: Well, Master, uhhh... I dunnooooo!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: What is with this insufferable... Hey,[n]Inmate! Do you really think you get[n]proper rehabilitation here!?
You get used to it.
You don't like it?
I dunnooooo!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: So you're saying you're learning how it[n]feels to be a slave...? Hmph, I don't like[n]the sound of that at all!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: It's safe to say I'm well beyond disliking it!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: You lookin' to get executed!?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Calm yourself, Caroline.

entries.speaker: Clara
entries.en: Aw, aren't you just the cutest? *giggle*

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Watch it! You think laughing at your[n]masters is proper discipline?

entries.speaker: Clara
entries.en: *gasp* Ohhhhh, NOW I get it!

entries.speaker: Clara
entries.en: You're here for the discipline service,[n]is that it?

entries.speaker: Clara
entries.en: Then listen up, you little shrimp!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Wha—!?

entries.speaker: Clara
entries.en: Quit gawkin' at me and order already![n]You wanna get jabbed with one o' those[n]tiny little shrimp forks!? Out with it!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Sh-She's thrown off the yoke[n]of oppression...!

entries.speaker: Clara
entries.en: WHAT DID I JUST SAY!? Order! Or do you[n]need a menu—if you can even read! Is that[n]it? Widdle baby can't wead a menu?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: A-Ahh...
Just the usual service, actually.
Let's take it down a notch.
Please don't harass the kids.

entries.speaker: Clara
entries.en: As you wish, Master—here's the menu![n]What can I bring you today?

entries.speaker: Clara
entries.en: Ohhh, so you wanted the normal service[n]after all? Whoopsy-daisy, I got ahead of[n]myself there!

entries.speaker: Clara
entries.en: Here's the menu!

entries.speaker: Clara
entries.en: Oh, was I overdoing it? Whoopsy-daisy,[n]I got a bit caught up there!

entries.speaker: Clara
entries.en: Here's the menu!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Wh-What is wrong with her... Her mood[n]changes in an instant.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Such versatility... Could she possess the[n]potential for the power of the wild card?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Well, never mind that. We are to focus[n]on the matter at hand.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: What could this be?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Love★Pancake? What do they put in it?[n]Nothing suspicious, I hope...
Love.
Poison.
It's a surprise.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: They put "love" in it? How is that possible?[n]Love isn't a physical substance! Have they[n]been scamming you here?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Let's order something else.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Oh, I see! This is how the slave's rebellious[n]will manifests! Even the food industry is[n]a matter of life and death in this world.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Let's order something else.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Could this be a form of what some call[n]"Russian roulette"?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: We can't risk the odds of being poisoned.[n]Let's order something else.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: In that case, let's go with the Sincere[n]Omelette.

entries.speaker: Clara
entries.en: As you wish, Master.

entries.speaker: Clara
entries.en: Oh no! I messed it up. Please forgive me,[n]Masterrrrr!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: How... DARE you!? Fix this right now![n]You can beg for forgiveness once[n]I receive a perfectly sincere meal!

entries.speaker: Clara
entries.en: But... but... I filled it with love...

entries.speaker: Clara
entries.en: Waaah...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Don't even try that fake-cry act on me!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Fix it! Double time! I'm not letting you off[n]until it's right!

entries.speaker: Clara
entries.en: N-No, I... I can't... I tried so, so hard... but[n]I'm just so clumsy... I even practiced a ton,[n]and... and...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Uh— Hey...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: How could you make this poor slave[n]cry like that...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Wha—!? Fine, fine, I'll say I'm sorry!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Look, slav— I mean, maid! I'm sorry![n]I'll eat it, I'll eat it! Just... stop crying!

entries.speaker: Clara
entries.en: You will!? Yaaaay! Thank you so much!

entries.speaker: Clara
entries.en: Would you care for some Oo-hot Tea to[n]go with it? I also recommend the Relaxing[n]Coffee!

entries.speaker: Clara
entries.en: I promise to pour aaaall my heart into[n]making them for youuuu!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Fine, just bring whatever...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: This has been so tiresome...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Even the people being served have to[n]behave a certain way... I struggle to[n]comprehend why it's so complicated.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: And yet, people here are willing to pay[n]good money to partake in this master-[n]servant charade...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: The lengths that humans will go to hold[n]positions of power... Their desires truly[n]appear to be limitless.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Anyway, we hereby deem your assignment[n]complete.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Here is your reward.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: I feel as though we saw a side of humanity[n]today that was new to us.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: As a matter of fact... This isn't a new event[n]to us at this point.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: We do seem to witness curious new facets[n]of humanity with each special assignment[n]we undertake.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Most intriguing indeed...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: But the only thing that matters to YOU[n]is your rehabilitation—and don't you[n]forget it!
I escorted the twins back[n]to the Velvet Room...
